correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all three possible equality patterns. Two equal entries reduce to one cubic with a sharp local maximum and a double-root threshold. Three distinct entries force a specific cubic through divided recurrence differences, and Viète identities plus the summed residual establish the converse for all root permutations. The discriminant exactly yields the second threshold. The Jacobian return formula and six exact positive Schur inequalities at the rational witness certify two hyperbolic sinks, and simple roots persist under perturbation. Actual packaged CHECK.py reproduces all its exact-rational witness identities; finite checks are not misused as proofs of continuum exhaustiveness.

value.rationale: The original work poses the dynamics of three-period orbits in a broad nilpotent-Jacobian family and gives existence, leaving exact multiplicity and coexistence unresolved. The natural quadratic defining polynomial has an entire four-phase count 1,2,3,5 with two sharp arithmetic folds; the second transition creates orientation-distinct cycles and an explicit pair of hyperbolic attractors. This is a complete natural period classification and an exact multi-attractor boundary, rather than an arbitrary finite computation or renaming of prior results.
